prompt: The parish church of Renče, Slovenia, is dedicated to two saints. What would be the tropical zodiac sign of someone born on the date of their annual festival?
answer: The parish church is dedicated to **Saints Mohor and Fortunat**, whose annual feast is celebrated on **22 September**. In the tropical zodiac, 22 September is generally **Virgo** (though it can fall very near the Virgo–Libra cusp depending on the year and exact birth time).
